subject: Television & Streaming
title: Indian Television: A Billion Viewers
description: A fast breakdown of Indian Television: A Billion Viewers for builders.

hook.text: India has over 900 television channels broadcasting in dozens of languages.

buildup.text: Indian serials run for thousands of episodes.

discovery.text: Ramayan, a 1987 Hindu epic series, drew 650 million viewers per episode during its 2020 rerun. A world record.

twist.text: Streaming is disrupting Indian TV rapidly.

climax.text: Indian Television matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: One country's TV audience is larger than most continents'.

quiz.question: What record does the 2020 rerun of Ramayan hold in television history?
options: Most-watched show in human history with 650 million viewers per episode
